packet.diagnosis: All five rows qualify under September's approved posted_on rule. The application negates every RETURN, producing contributions [100000, 20000, -5000, 50000, -10000]. ATLAS schema 1 requires preserving signed amounts, including positive return reversals; schema 2 requires subtracting return magnitudes. The justified contributions are [100000, -20000, 5000, 50000, -10000], totaling 125000 cents. The application therefore overstates sales by 30000 cents. The customer's 115000 cents matches forcing every return negative, which mishandles A-3's reversal; the actual spreadsheet formula is unavailable. No applicable documentation conflict prevents this conclusion.
